description: This file implements a simple text aggregator class for sentence boundary detection in TTS text processing. It accumulates text, detects sentence endings using punctuation and lookahead logic, and yields completed sentences as Aggregation objects.

classes.name: SimpleTextAggregator
classes.description: A straightforward text aggregator that accumulates text until sentence boundaries are detected, suitable for basic sentence segmentation in TTS applications.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the text buffer and lookahead flag for sentence boundary detection.

methods.name: Aggregation text(self)
methods.description: Returns the currently accumulated text as an Aggregation object with SENTENCE type.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[Aggregation] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously processes input text character-by-character, detecting sentence boundaries and yielding completed sentences.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] _check_sentence_with_lookahead(self, char: str)
methods.description: Core method implementing sentence boundary detection with lookahead logic, calling external sentence matching functions.

methods.name: Optional[Aggregation] flush(self)
methods.description: Returns any remaining text in the buffer as an Aggregation object, called at the end of processing.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Clears the internal text buffer in case processing is interrupted.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the aggregator, clearing accumulated text and flags.

ctags.name: aggregate
ctags.pattern: /^    async def aggregate(self, text: str) -> AsyncIterator[Aggregation]:$/
